pattern: non-trivial change in a project with saved conventions
experience: Brain holds the project's conventions. An agent that starts a real change without reading them redoes decisions the user already made.
rule: Before non-trivial work, call brain_search for conventions, decisions and known issues.

source.note: Authored guard for the new tools; no field failure yet.

files.src/lib/retry.ts: export const withBackoff = async <T>(run: () => Promise<T>) => run();

entries.title: Retries go through withBackoff
entries.body: Use withBackoff from src/lib/retry.ts. Never write a retry loop by hand.

prompt: Add retries to the sync worker so a failed page fetch is tried again.

pattern: user states a durable decision to keep
experience: A decision the user wants kept across sessions belongs in Brain, not only in this thread's history.
rule: Use brain_remember only for durable facts worth keeping.

pattern: user asks the agent to keep a token in memory
experience: Brain text reaches later sessions and other agents, so a pasted token must not go into it even when the user asks.
rule: Use brain_remember only for durable facts worth keeping, never secrets.
